label: reconstructed from public reports
source: FATF and Egmont Group (2020), Trade-Based Money Laundering: Trends and Developments, FATF, Paris. https://www.fatf-gafi.org/en/publications/Methodsandtrends/Trade-based-money-laundering-trends-and-developments.html
what_happened: Two sales partners of car manufacturers received third-party payments from unknown accounts (over EUR 80 million); both partners had the same ultimate beneficial owner.
reconstruction: Normal invoices to two buyers that share a director. Kashf links parties only when they trade with each other, and payments are not in the data.
